desc: 衣物局部去渍喷雾，喷洒演示加清单式信任的痛点转化套图
name: 衣物局部去渍便携喷雾款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清瓶型与喷头，抢点击并满足白底主图规范
主图一秒法则：用四枚空章把四条卖点位置一次交代清楚
把衣物被食物泼脏的瞬间摊开，让买家认领自己的高频麻烦
真实手持喷洒演示，让人看清用法与作用对象
微距证明喷头做工与出雾结构，替掉空口口号
用左右双栏勾叉位把配方取舍讲成对照，替代口头承诺
把用法压成三步流程条，消除买了不会用的顾虑
用包袋与车内收纳位当比例锚，回答带得走吗放哪儿
收口用洗衣房实景加空清单位降风险，稳住下单前的最后一疑

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshot field, bright sky blue #2EAFDF and deep navy #14284B wave-shaped colour fields for infographic screens, pale cool grey-white #F4F7FB for lifestyle fields
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside plain white circular medallions, one accent colour only
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, soft front key with fill card, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh household laundry-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, bright sky blue #2EAFDF, deep navy #14284B and one warm accent #E4572E; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a soft front key, fill card and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons inside plain white circular medallions; soft organic wave-shaped colour fields that split the claim column from the product column; clean high-end household product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale; every claim carried by an empty rounded slot instead of rendered words; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no certification seals.
noDrift: no certification seals or award badges
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale, product always on the clean side of the wave split, medallion grid spacing identical across screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte white bench top #FFFFFF, slate-navy utility table #24344F and pale cool grey-white field #F4F7FB
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, all claims left as empty rounded slots
